description: F7 rule 3 golden: simulator rule 6b, parent impact (docs/API_REFERENCE.md section 2.13 P0-1; iap.execution.simulator._parent_impact is the reference). Each scenario replays `events` (golden:events_eq_mbo.jsonl = tests/golden/events_eq_mbo.jsonl; slice = the real slice, see `slice`) through ExecutionReplay(config, parents) and records every fill ([fill_id, order_id, parent_id, instrument_id, venue_id, side, price_ticks, qty, ts, liquidity, fee, impact_cost]), every child ([order_id, parent_id, venue_id, side, type, limit_ticks, qty, decision_ts, expire_ts, state, remaining, cancel_reason]) and the per-parent report (keyed by parent_id as a string). The third scenario is the rule-6 control under the same parents.
parity: canonical JSON bytes of `expected` (sorted keys, no whitespace, Python float repr) must equal the C++ port's canonical bytes; `expected_tol` (when present) is compared to `tolerance`

golden stream, square-root parent adder + permanent leg

slice.rule: a sample is taken after applying the k-th event (1-based) whenever k > prefix_events and k % sample_every == 0
